title: Little Fish: This Is A Song
content:
James tells us the only joke so-far in his hour of standup, while he, Anna and Andy discuss YOUR facts. This week's subjects include vampires, fires and football identifiers. And the gang announce eight more Friend of the Podcast custodians.

Visit nosuchthingasafish.com for news about live shows, merchandise and more episodes.

Edited by James Harkin

Produced by Leying Lee

Team includes Tara Dorrell, Joe Mayo and Ethan Ruparelia
